name: galley-editor
description: galley's edit-mode browser bundle. DEV-TIME ONLY: the built output lives in internal/serve/assets and is committed; `just assets` rebuilds it. Nothing at runtime needs node.

scripts.kit-share: go mod download github.com/subaud-tools/tools-common && KIT_DIR=$(go list -m -f '{{.Dir}}' github.com/subaud-tools/tools-common) && test -n "$KIT_DIR" && mkdir -p kit && cp -f "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/share.js" "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/share.css" kit/ && sed -n '/^\/\/ ---- share.js/,$p' "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/kit.d.ts" > kit/share.d.ts && chmod 644 kit/share.js kit/share.css kit/share.d.ts
scripts.build: npm run --silent kit-share && npm run --silent build:editor-js && npm run --silent build:editor-css && npm run --silent build:mermaid && npm run --silent probe
